name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the generated continuation is related to the conversation context and the interesting fact provided. A relevant response should be on-topic and take into account the information given.

name: Coherence
description: The degree to which the generated continuation is coherent and logically follows from the conversation context and the interesting fact provided. A coherent response should make sense in the context of the conversation and should not contain contradictions or non-sequiturs.

name: Fluency
description: The degree to which the generated continuation is fluent and grammatically correct. A fluent response should be easy to read and understand, and should not contain errors in grammar, spelling, or punctuation.

name: Informativeness
description: The degree to which the generated continuation provides new and interesting information. An informative response should contribute to the conversation and provide value to the user.

name: Engagement
description: The degree to which the generated continuation is engaging and holds the user's attention. An engaging response should be interesting, entertaining, and emotionally resonant.
